Method of Attack: Exploitation of vulnerability in SIP inspection engine causing device restart (denial-of-service)
Sending SIP requests at high rate to trigger improper handling of SIP traffic
High CPU usage leading to device slowdown
Impacted Systems: ASA Services Module for Cisco Catalyst 6500 Series Switches and Cisco 7600 Series Routers
Attack Vector: Remote attack with no authentication needed via SIP traffic
Indicators of Compromise: SIP traffic with 'Sent-by Address' header set to 0.0.0.0 (invalid value)
